scripts.verify: pnpm --filter @slide-spec/shared verify && pnpm --filter @slide-spec/cli verify && pnpm --filter @slide-spec/app verify && pnpm --filter @slide-spec/docs verify
scripts.security:trivy: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/repo" aquasec/trivy:0.67.2 fs --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig --format sarif --output /repo/trivy-results.sarif /repo
scripts.security:semgrep: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/src" semgrep/semgrep:1.124.0 semgrep scan --config auto --error --json --output /src/semgrep-results.json /src
